entries.governance/presets/default/checks.yml#hu:
human-approval-present: {statement: An approval record exists for an irreversible change., kind: deterministic,
    impl: human-approval-present, severity: blocking, on_skipped: fail, locked: hard}
entries.governance/presets/default/gates.yml#G5:
G5:
    kind: guardrail
    name: A human signs off on the irreversible
    statement: 'A change that can lose data, move money, or breach auth or privacy gets an explicit human
      checkpoint before it lands.

      '
    stage: ship
    applies_to: {ships: true}
    when:
      any_of:
      - labels_any: [auth, payments, personal-data, migrations]
      - {risk: critical}
    checks: [human-approval-present]
    locked: hard
